samples.summary: `sheets export` prints its progress notice on stdout, contaminating the body stream that the clarified `--quiet` contract now reserves for machine-readable output
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-export.ts:52-54 — `if (!opts.quiet) { console.log(`Exported to ${file}`); }`. Every other progress notice in the CLI (`src/output/binary.ts:39`, `src/docs/content.ts:107/112/120/142`, `src/slides/content.ts:96/105`, `src/commands/docs.ts:292/307`) goes to stderr via `io.stderr`/`console.error`, and docs/design/cli.md §9 (lines 925-935) defines stdout as the body and stderr as notices. The diff's whole premise is that stdout is the stream callers redirect; this one remaining stdout notice is the odd consumer left inconsistent with the newly stated split. Fix belongs on the out-of-diff line: switch it to `console.error`.

samples.summary: Error envelope emitted by the now-always-on `outputError` omits the `command` field that docs/design/cli.md §9 specifies, so agents consuming quiet-mode errors get a shape different from the documented one
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:930-931 documents `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…","command":"docs.content"}}`, but `packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:54-56` emits only `code` and `message`. This mattered less when `--quiet` suppressed the envelope entirely; now that it is always emitted (and documented as the machine-readable failure signal in packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:109), the divergence from the spec'd shape reaches every consumer. Pre-existing line, surfaced by the contract change.

samples.summary: No caller anywhere still passes the removed third/second `quiet` argument — the contract change is fully propagated
searchedFor: Grep 'quiet' across packages/, packages/cli/test, packages/cli/skills, docs/design/cli.md, packages/documentation/developers/cli.md
Read packages/cli/src/bin.ts, commands/schema.ts, sheets-export.ts, docs/content.ts, slides/content.ts, docs/import.ts
samples.evidence: All 11 command modules that import `output`/`outputError` (api-keys, cells, docs, notes, slides, tabs, schema, sheets-import, sheets-export) are updated in the diff; the only other reference is packages/cli/test/output.test.ts, also updated. README (packages/cli/README.md:74-76), packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:109 and docs/design/cli.md:926-935 already describe the new semantics. Body-producing paths that bypass `output()` (docs/content.ts:137-142, slides/content.ts:100-105, docs/import.ts:167) already print the body regardless of `quiet`, so no bypass of the new contract exists there.
